angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop bend (Hoop G) vs NFL pressure rate, with drill-vs-game cards (NFL Arc G from the game-tracking sample), an imputation-free baseline and a best-of-14 selection test
metric_name: Hoop G: the hardest sideways push a rusher holds for 0.5 s while rounding the hoops (g, z within Combine year), shrunk by one-run reliability 0.41
headline_number: Hoop G vs pressure after log pick + weight + NGS athleticism + EDGE share (no imputation): rho 0.32 [0.06, 0.54], n=63; held-out R2 0.085 -> 0.188 (+0.103); best-of-14 permutation p=0.121 (headline selection p); EB-shrunk 0.09 = ~0.8 pressures per season; on the 49 who ran the 40 the effect is 0.18 and the forecast gain is -0.002
what_changed_from_previous: Revised round_03/cand_1 per judges. (1) Imputation: main baseline now uses only fully observed covariates (NGS athleticism score replaces the 10-yd split); variants with no athletic score, 10-yd multiple imputation (M=20), the round-3 single fill, and complete-case 49 with + official 10-yd / + official 40, each with baseline-alone vs +Hoop G R2 on identical rows; the share that survives is stated (in-sample ~56%, forecast gain only where the 40 is missing). (2) Selection: headline p is now best-of-14 (7 metrics x 2 outcomes), nested re-selection over all 14, EB over 14, plus a train-on-one-class/predict-two check; contradictions (6 vs 7 metrics, 14 vs 15 missing, 0.007 vs 0.009) removed. (3) Reliability: disattenuated effect with joint bootstrap (split-half and 10 repeat runners), board-order stability (rho with plausible true orders, top-5 retention). (4) Football: EDGE vs interior split, snap-level odds on edge-aligned vs inside snaps and on true passing downs, survivorship/snap-share exclusion line, 2025 board table with names/weights/role/pick, scout call per Fig 1 card, Combine protocol (3-4 runs) and Downs re-test advice. (5) Writing: football-first 70-word opening, 'Why this matters', stats moved to appendix, Finding 2 table at 4 data columns, Arc G chain folded into Fig 2. (6) Viz: Fig 1 rebuilt (same 11-yd scale, attached horizontal 'sideways g' colorbar, Arc-G window dots, one shared 0-15% strip with right-side labels, names with pick, takeaway title); Fig 2 now 3 outcomes with raw->after arrows, hexbin/reliability dropped; Fig 3 shows baseline variants and a single best-of-14 null with annotation in open space; Fig 4 is a 20-rookie dumbbell with plain-text flags and a football title. 4 figures + 3 tables.
open_risks: The headline no longer clears selection: best-of-14 p=0.121 and nested p=0.091; judges may read it as a null.

The out-of-class gain rests on the 14 rushers without an official 40 (rho 0.51 inside that group vs 0.14 among the 49 who ran); 'the hoop helps where the 40 is missing' is a hypothesis from 14 players.
Snap-level rush-type and passing-down splits are uninformative (all odds-ratio intervals include 1) on 20 random snaps per player.
Disattenuated effect 0.57 has a CI reaching 1.00 because split-half reliability is uncertain (0.14-0.60).
Full script takes about 10 minutes; nothing committed.
